notes:
REF-BM-06: Duplicate creation is prevented and a message identifies the existing item, but the UI does not open or link to its editor.
REF-BM-14: Tag search uses tag:name syntax rather than the required #tag syntax.
REF-BM-21: All-matching bulk actions are scoped to current criteria but silently cap targets at 10,000.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF preservation is implemented.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support is implemented.
REF-BM-29: Saved views preserve queries and included tag filters, but have no explicit excluded-tag filter field or control.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are not implemented.
